data.title: Find the *mode selector*
data.subtitle: It sits in the chat box. Change it whenever the work changes.

composer.text: Summarise the files in Inbox for my manager. Save it in Outputs.

steps: Open the **mode selector** in the chat box
Everyday work in your folder: **Automatically approve**
Money, messages or key files: **Manually approve**
data.note: Drawn from Anthropic's help pages, not a screenshot. New Claude experience: the permission setting offers Auto and Manual. Your screen may differ.
